centralized_aaa_enabled.title: Centralized AAA Enabled
centralized_aaa_enabled.description: All identities governed through a central directory/SSO with no unmanaged local accounts. Secure when true.

provisioning_requires_approval.title: Provisioning Requires Approval
provisioning_requires_approval.description: Provisioning follows a documented approved joiner/role-change workflow. Secure when true.

offboarding_credential_revocation_enforc.title: Offboarding Credential Revocation Enforced
offboarding_credential_revocation_enforc.description: Access is revoked and accounts disabled promptly on termination or role exit. Secure when true.

dormant_admin_accounts_disabled.title: Dormant Admin Accounts Disabled
dormant_admin_accounts_disabled.description: Dormant and orphaned accounts are automatically disabled. Secure when true.

dormant_account_disable_window_days.title: Dormant Account Disable Window (Days)
dormant_account_disable_window_days.description: Days before a dormant account is disabled; <=45 is secure (NIST AC-2(3)).

least_privilege_access_enforced.title: Least-Privilege Access Enforced
least_privilege_access_enforced.description: Entitlements are assigned per least privilege. Secure when true.

periodic_privilege_recertification.title: Periodic Privilege Recertification
periodic_privilege_recertification.description: Entitlements are reviewed on a recertification cadence and unjustified privileges removed. Secure when true.

segregation_of_duties_enforced.title: Segregation of Duties Enforced
segregation_of_duties_enforced.description: Toxic entitlement combinations are blocked at grant or flagged during recertification. Secure when true.

no_shared_privileged_credentials.title: No Shared Privileged Credentials
no_shared_privileged_credentials.description: Admin work uses dedicated individually-attributable accounts with no shared credentials. Secure when true.

mfa_enforced_for_admin.title: MFA Enforced for Admin
mfa_enforced_for_admin.description: MFA is enforced centrally for admin, remote, and external access. Secure when true.

breached_password_screening_enabled.title: Breached Password Screening Enabled
breached_password_screening_enabled.description: Credential policy screens against breach/common-password lists (NIST 800-63B). Secure when true.

rate_limiting_or_lockout_enabled.title: Rate Limiting or Lockout Enabled
rate_limiting_or_lockout_enabled.description: Authentication rate-limiting/lockout protects against brute force and password spraying. Secure when true.

federation_trust_validated.title: Federation Trust Validated
federation_trust_validated.description: Federation/SSO trust relationships and assertions are validated by relying parties. Secure when true.

saml_assertion_signature_verified.title: SAML Assertion Signature Verified
saml_assertion_signature_verified.description: SAML/OIDC assertion signatures are verified over the full assertion. Secure when true.

audience_claim_validated.title: Audience Claim Validated
audience_claim_validated.description: Assertion audience-restriction is validated by every relying party, blocking cross-RP injection. Secure when true.

identity_access_audit_logging_enabled.title: Identity & Access Audit Logging Enabled
identity_access_audit_logging_enabled.description: Account-lifecycle and authN/authZ events are logged centrally with credentials scrubbed. Secure when true.

service_account_inventory_governed.title: Service Account Inventory Governed
service_account_inventory_governed.description: Service (non-human) identities are inventoried and governed alongside human accounts. Secure when true.
